integrity: All claims follow from the printed monomial-moment identity, closed-form series, and exhaustive Cayley/logarithm zero argument. Numerical checks are supporting diagnostics, not infinite proofs. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Exact theorem only for the unit disk with Euclidean distance weight; literature coverage cannot be certified exhaustively, and two plausibly relevant manuscripts could not be read in full.
title: Sharp Lu Qi-Keng transitions for Euclidean boundary-distance weighted disk kernels
